claims.claim_text: The dues-share resolution proposes doubling local chapters' share of dues to 40% of all dues income by 2027 and thereafter.
The dues-share resolution aims to give local chapters resources to build and sustain new organizing.
The dues-share resolution proposes ratifying and increasing the national reserves policy to stabilize the national budget.
The dues-share resolution proposes giving chapters the option to receive monthly disbursements.
The dues-share resolution proposes guardrails against cutting dues share if the organization's financial health worsens.
The unified-endorsement amendment proposes abolishing DSA's two-tier endorsement process, which separates local chapter endorsements from the NPC's national endorsement.
The unified-endorsement amendment proposes a process under which candidates endorsed by their local chapter would be considered endorsed by DSA as a whole.
The unified-endorsement amendment proposes standardizing endorsement criteria across chapters.
The unified-endorsement amendment proposes establishing a consistent endorsement revocation process applicable to all endorsed candidates.
The unified-endorsement amendment proposes making all endorsed candidates eligible to benefit from the full power of DSA's mass membership and national organization.
